dedupe_keys.name: efficient use of cement and concrete to reduce reliance on supply side technologies for net zero emissions

description: Takuma Watari and Zhi Cao publish system models and datasets for the Japanese cement and concrete cycle. Zenodo archives version 1.0 under CC BY 4.0; the linked repository identifies MIT code rights and cites the published Nature Communications article. The workflow explores material-use strategies for lowering production emissions and the need for supply-side technologies. It can inform concrete-demand, recycling or capacity scenarios for construction infrastructure. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Japan-specific cement-cycle implementation. Coverage is the national material cycle and study assumptions, not a plant-by-plant production census. A limitation is that demand, service life, recycling rates and technology emissions must be aligned before transferring results to another country. Zenodo and GitHub expose different licence statements, so the scope of each applies to its own release and should be checked before redistribution. The archive was not downloaded, the system model was not run and no net-zero trajectory was reproduced.
